notes.content: Beginning competitor analysis for TaskFlow Pro
Competitor differentiator: TeamSync has AI Task Suggestions; ProjectHub has built-in chat; AgileBoard has best agile tooling; WorkStream has invoicing and client portals.
Competitive analysis complete. TaskFlow Pro mid-tier price $29 sits between AgileBoard standard ($15) and TeamSync business ($28). Key differentiators: integrations ecosystem and intuitive UI.
